instruction.text: Read and listen to the short story.

atoms.text: Alex the kingfisher was the only bird that had lots of blue feathers. The ducks had some blue feathers but not as many as Alex.
atoms.sound: ssml: King fisher <break time='1000ms'/>Alex the kingfisher was the only bird that had lots of blue feathers. The ducks had some blue feathers but not as many as Alex.

atoms.a: Which sentence summarises the beginning of this story?
b: ++Alex has a lot of blue feathers.
The ducks have a lot of blue feathers.
atoms.finishSound: Alex has a lot of blue feathers.

atoms.text: One night, Alex was asleep. Suddenly, he opened his eyes and looked down to see Sammy the duck pulling at his blue feathers.
atoms.sound: One night, Alex was asleep. Suddenly he opened his eyes and looked down to see Sammy the duck pulling at his blue feathers.

atoms.text:
Alex said “Stop! Leave my feathers alone!”

Sammy replied “I am so sorry, I just wanted some beautiful blue feathers for my wings. I want to be beautiful like you.”
atoms.sound: Alex said <voice voice='m1'> “Stop! Leave my feathers alone!” </voice> Sammy replied <voice voice='m3_2025'>“I am so sorry, I just wanted some beautiful blue feathers for my wings. I want to be beautiful like you.”</voice>

atoms.a: Which sentence summarises the middle of this story?
b: Sammy is really upset with Alex about the birdhouse.
++Sammy tries to take some of Alex’s blue feathers.

atoms.text: Alex took Sammy outside and showed Sammy his reflection in the river. Sammy saw that his dark blue feathers shone brilliantly in the moonlight.
atoms.sound: Alex took Sammy outside and showed Sammy his reflection in the river. Sammy saw that his dark blue feathers shone brilliantly in the moonlight.

atoms.text: “See,” said Alex, “You’re beautiful too, we’re just different.”Alex and Sammy became great friends.
atoms.sound: <voice voice='m1'> “See” </voice> said Alex, <voice voice='m1'>“You’re beautiful too, we’re just different.”</voice> Alex and Sammy became great friends.

atoms.a: Which sentence summarises the end of this story?
b: ++Sammy realises he is just as beautiful as Alex.
Alex decides to leave the birdhouse and explore the world.
